title: Mika hình thái 3 · gồng chiêu (sheet cast)

raise.note: tư thế gồng chiêu đã duyệt

style: Static locked camera, three-quarter view facing screen-right, matching the reference, the whole body and weapon always inside the frame with a margin, her face visible, the flat solid magenta background never changes. Clean anime game sprite animation, crisp lines. Hair, cloth and tails always keep moving with natural delay and follow-through, never frozen.

segments.name: T
segments.prompt: A chibi nine-tailed fox empress in white and gold armour with very long red hair and nine big fluffy fox tails fanned behind her, wielding a long-hafted crescent moon glaive, from her guard stance smoothly moves into the power stance of the last frame, gathering strength, a rising breeze lifting her hair, cloth and tails. Feet adjust minimally between the supplied endpoint stances, staying grounded without sliding or hopping; no turning or scale change. Arms, shoulders and torso drive the weapon action; hair, cloth and tails follow with natural overlapping motion. Preserve her identity, costume, proportions and the single rigid weapon, always drawn whole and clearly visible. No added flames, aura or particles.
